title.en: Twisty-puzzle mechanism cutaway and turn explanation

summary: Use a patent-grounded 3×3 mechanism example to explain how centers, sliding piece connectors and an interior element retain pieces while a face layer turns, clearly labeling illustrative clearance and physics limits.
objective: A viewer can isolate center, edge, corner, connector and core roles, follow one layer turn, and distinguish cited mechanism relationships from invented display geometry.
intent_signals: show why the internal core permits a turn
explain Rubik cube center edge corner retention
example_prompts: Create a cutaway of one disclosed 3×3 puzzle mechanism and animate a top-layer turn without presenting it as a universal speedcube design.
negative_signals: copy patent figure as a model
not_for: Manufacturing dimensions, patent advice, product safety or comparative performance.
A physical simulation of spring load, friction, wear, flex or corner cutting.

entities.name: Core and center connection
entities.guidance: Show the interior element and one center connector/sleeve relationship as the fixed reference for a face axis.

entities.name: Edge and corner feet
entities.guidance: Expose simplified sliding connector forms that remain retained by the interior element while changing slots.

entities.name: Cutaway controls
entities.guidance: Offer assembled, sectioned, isolated, exploded and turn-step states with an always-visible illustrative label.

state_contract.model: One cited mechanism family is represented by semantic components and authored cutaway/explode parameters; a separate standard 3×3 discrete move engine owns piece permutation and orientation.
state_contract.authority: The patent claim supports named relationships only. The application's discrete puzzle state owns the turn; cutaway and exploded transforms are explanatory presentation.
actions: Isolate core, center, edge or corner role.
Move a clipping plane or explode slider without changing assembly state.
Step one named outer-face turn and reset all presentation controls.

invariants: A cutaway never changes the legal piece permutation or orientation.
The center role remains on its face axis while moving edge and corner roles change slots under the move engine.
Invented clearances, section colors and simplified feet are labeled illustrative and never reported as measured from the patent.
Reset restores assembled transforms, clipping state, labels and puzzle state.
motion_guidance: In Blender, model original simplified shells and connector sections from the cited relationships rather than tracing patent figures; leave clearance gaps visible and author an exploded hierarchy.
Export semantic role IDs, face-axis pivots and assembled matrices; Three.js owns clipping, isolation, explode amount and synchronized legal-turn playback.
During a turn, fade or section nonparticipating shells and keep the retained connector path visible without pretending collision response is computed.

object_craft.structure: Central interior body, one center sleeve/connector, and simplified edge/corner feet with sectional thickness and readable mating paths.
object_craft.material: Neutral opaque shells, darker core and distinct section-surface hatch; avoid glass-only depth confusion.
object_craft.articulation: Outer layer follows the exact face pivot; explode and clipping transforms remain independent.

object_craft.structure: Beveled center, edge and corner bodies with separated face tiles and enough authored gap for the illustration.
object_craft.material: Low-gloss bodies with patterned face tiles and a diagnostic interior accent.
object_craft.articulation: Moving shells follow the discrete turn group and return to rebuilt exact endpoints.

physical_contract.scope: Patent-informed explanatory geometry only; no contact, friction, elasticity, tolerance stack or manufacturing validation.
checks: No visible interpenetration in the authored section sequence.
Labels continuously distinguish cited relationships from illustrative geometry.

creative_affordances: Use a quarter-section, peel-away shell, exploded ring or synchronized schematic inset.
Simplify hidden geometry according to the teaching question while keeping role and retention path explicit.
known_limits: The cited patent describes one embodiment and refers to classic mechanics; this recipe does not claim universality or reproduce exact dimensions.
No CAD comparison, patent figure reproduction, collision test, mechanism assembly or turn was run.

claims.statement: US6974130B2 describes a 3×3×3 embodiment with 26 center, corner and edge elements connected to an interior element; its center connector is rigidly connected to a sleeve while corner and edge connectors slidingly interconnect with the interior element, allowing those pieces to change positions as a face plate rotates.
claims.scope: Relationships in the cited disclosed embodiment, especially Figures 1 and 3–7; not dimensions, universal modern speedcube construction, friction or clearance performance.

source_refs.locator: Detailed Description, paragraphs describing Figures 1 and 3–7; elements 21–24 and connectors 41–43
